description: Photovoltaic system power production is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Konrad Kuczyński (Poznan Supercomputing and Networking Center). The dataset contains data related to the photovoltaic (PV) system installed at Poznan Supercomputing and Networking Center used to power the servers in one of the server rooms. The data come from a 1-month measurement period taken between 03.09.2019-03.10.2019. The PV system consists of 80 PV panels with 20kW peak power. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is ODC-BY-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
